mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_device WHERE TRIM(device_status) = 'NORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_device WHERE TRIM(device_status) = 'ERROR'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_device WHERE TRIM(device_status) = 'WARNING'

SELECT d.device_id AS deviceId, d.device_name AS deviceName, TRIM(d.device_type) AS deviceType, d.ip_address AS ipAddress, TRIM(d.device_status) AS deviceStatus, s.name AS stationName, g.group_name AS groupName, s.address AS stationAddress, s.lat, s.lng, TO_CHAR(d.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(d.last_received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latestReceivedAt, TRIM(d.last_receive_status) AS latestReceivedStatus, CASE WHEN k.received_at IS NOT NULL AND (r.received_at IS NULL OR k.received_at > r.received_at) THEN k.file_name ELSE END AS latestData FROM public.tb_device d LEFT JOIN public.tb_observation_station s ON s.station_id = d.station_id LEFT JOIN public.tb_device_group g ON g.group_id = d.group_id LEFT JOIN public.tb_dcs_data r ON r.dcs_data_id = ( SELECT x.dcs_data_id FROM public.tb_dcs_data x WHERE x.device_id = d.device_id AND x.received_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_dcs_receive_details parsed WHERE parsed.dcs_data_id = x.dcs_data_id AND parsed.parse_status = 'PARSED' ) ORDER BY x.received_at DESC, x.dcs_data_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN public.tb_ka_data k ON k.ka_data_id = ( SELECT x.ka_data_id FROM public.tb_ka_data x WHERE x.device_id = d.device_id AND x.received_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.received_at DESC, x.ka_data_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY d.device_id

SELECT TO_CHAR(checked_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS receivedAt, status_message AS dataPayload, TRIM(device_status) AS receivedStatus FROM public.tb_device_status WHERE device_id = CAST(#{deviceId} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT station_id, name, lat, lng, address, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at FROM public.tb_observation_station ORDER BY station_id
